title: Study of solutions of certain type of non-linear differential-difference equations
summary: In this paper, we analyze the solutions of the following non-linear differential-difference equations f^n(z) +ωf^(n-1)f'(z) +p(z)f(z+c) = p_1e^α_1z +p_2e^α_2z and f^n(z)f'(z) +q(z)e^Q(z)f(z+c) = p_1e^α_1z +p_2e^α_2z, where n is a positive integer,ω, p1, p2,α1 & α2 are non-zero constants satisfying α1 not equal to α2, α1/α2 not equal to (n)^+-1, q(z) is a non-vanishing polynomial and Q(z) is a non-constant polynomial.
